title: 角色创建后随机添加负面特质，例如刚移除的不适合特质又出现
description: 角色创建后随机添加负面特质，例如刚移除的不适合特质又出现
evidence: When it comes to traits you randomly get bad ones added back after character creation which while not impossible irl, in a game it's annoying to see traits like unfit (which takes 3 years to remove) show up again after I just got rid of it
